svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 255 mm off 90 x 15 mm flat; mill or file to 255 x 88 x 14 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Square nose; break every edge about 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each side: three M4 tapped holes 10 deep, 7 mm up from the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face, at 80, 140 and 200 mm from the rear end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nose: two M4 tapped holes 8 deep, 4.5 mm up from the bottom face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 and 16 mm to the crawler's left of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear: one M8 hole, drilled 6.8 and tapped through, on the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 9 mm from the rear end (the eye bolt).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint or zinc plate after drilling; keep the top face flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the hull floor sits on the top face; the hull's front overhangs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nose by 5 mm and the plate sticks out 20 mm behind the hull.
